about.biography: Sultan Sajed Shahriar is a Computer Engineering undergraduate at BRAC University and a full-stack developer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. As Lead Developer at Al-Mursalaat Online Academy he architected and shipped a complete FastAPI + Next.js platform, from Ubuntu server configuration to secure authentication. His ongoing thesis explores quantum cryptography, and his engineering interests span cyber security, AI agent orchestration, and system design.
about.aims: To complete thesis research in quantum cryptography, ship Master Sentinel v1.0, and grow into security-focused systems engineering where AI tooling meets defense of critical infrastructure.
